About Our Business

Built around quality. Focused on usefulness.

Balaji Plastic presents practical plastic product solutions for household and everyday applications. Our brand stands for precision in plastics and a commitment to quality, reliability and customer satisfaction.

Plastic Products for Everyday Use

Balaji Plastic presents practical plastic products for household and everyday applications. The product range shown on this website includes kitchen and household storage items, along with a manufacturing showcase. Our goal is to help customers find useful products that balance everyday convenience, functional design and dependable service. Product details, colours, dimensions and availability can vary, so please contact us to confirm the current specifications before placing an order.

Kitchen and Household Storage Solutions

Organised storage can make daily kitchen routines simpler. Our featured tea, coffee and sugar canister set includes three containers, each with an 800 ml capacity, made from PP plastic and shown in the Sand Castle colour. The set is intended for storing common kitchen ingredients such as tea, coffee and sugar. Please check the product description and ask our team about the available quantity, packaging and care recommendations. Customers should use each product according to its intended purpose and keep it clean and dry as appropriate for the stored contents.

Plastic Product Manufacturing

Plastic products can be useful when they are designed around the needs of the people who use them. Balaji Plastic highlights a plastic moulding machine in its manufacturing gallery to give visitors a view of production equipment. The machine shown is identified as an ST-90 servo moulding machine. The gallery is intended as a visual introduction; it should not be treated as a complete technical specification of our manufacturing capability. For details about a particular product, production requirements, material, colour, dimensions, or order quantity, please contact us directly.

Our Approach to Quality

Our brand message, “Precision in Plastics, Excellence in Quality,” reflects the values we want customers to associate with Balaji Plastic. We focus on useful products, clear communication and customer service. Before confirming an order, customers can discuss their intended application and ask for the product information they need to make an informed decision. We aim to respond clearly to business enquiries and help customers understand the available product options. Specific quality certifications, testing standards or material approvals should be confirmed with our team where they are required for a purchase.

Who Can Contact Balaji Plastic?

Household product buyers and business customers can contact us to ask about the products featured on this website. If you are interested in the canister set or another household plastic item, mention the product name and the quantity you need. For business enquiries, share your intended use, preferred specifications and expected order quantity so we can understand your requirements. Availability and commercial terms should be confirmed directly; this website does not promise stock levels, delivery dates or prices that have not been quoted.

How to Make an Enquiry

To enquire about a product, call Balaji Plastic at +91 87809 62728. You can ask about product specifications, current availability, colours, pack details and bulk-order requirements. Including the product name in your enquiry helps us understand what you are looking for. We recommend confirming all product, price, shipping and payment details directly before finalising an order.
